name: Default Team Hitter
dsl:
?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ self | ?(self.beneficial_auras == 0) any<aura & out_damage> | any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ boss | any<global> | any<shadow> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ self | pass
{1} ?(deck.remaining >= 2) any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage & aoe>) & any<mod_damage> @ spell(any<damage>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & sharp @ spell(any<blade>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) & potent @ spell(any<trap>) | ?(self.health < 30%) any<heal> @ self | ?(all(enemies).is_boss == 0) any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | "Feint Mass - Amulet" | any<trap & !aoe & stacks>[potent] @ boss | any<blade & stacks>[sharp] @ self | ?(self.beneficial_auras == 0) any<aura & out_damage> | any<damage & aoe>[any<mod_damage>] | any<damage>[any<mod_damage>] @ boss | any<global> | any<shadow> | any<trap & !aoe>[potent] @ boss | any<blade>[sharp] @ self | pass
description: Default hitter for a team: P1 of Default Team Duel, and every player of Everyone Attacks. In round 1 of a mob fight it attacks with AoE. Otherwise it plays as Default: below 30% health it heals itself, it buffs while a buff adds to the next hit, then hits with AoE or single-target at the boss, and keeps its buffs when short of pips.
